newsitem.title: USA: Noble Affiliates was high bidder on tracts.
newsitem.headline: Noble Affiliates was high bidder on tracts.

text.p: Noble Affiliates Inc said Thursday it submitted the high bids for 12 tracts at the Central Gulf of Mexico lease sale Wednesday.
It said the Garden Banks and East Breaks tracts are located in water depths ranging from 400 feet to 3,850 feet and the company has interests ranging from 25 percent to 100 percent.
The company said its share of the high bids, if they are accepted by the Minerals Management Service, will be $3.2 million. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
